location: Nauvis - New Dawn - Water Processing Sector
summary: Today ended up being another maintenance-focused day, tying up loose ends across the base.
I configured turret target priorities and updated all relevant blueprints. This should significantly improve response against high-threat enemies such as nuclear and suicide-type biters.
I also set up the ash output belts from both water processing sectors. Somehow this was overlooked earlier, but the issue has now been corrected and should reduce manual intervention.
Steel production has been reintroduced in a more automated form. While still relatively small in scale, it is far more efficient than the previous temporary setup.
To prevent bottlenecks, I expanded both soot and iron storage capacity. This should allow production chains to continue running without frequent interruptions.
I rerouted coal to join the northern boiler and main fuel line, ensuring that the wood-to-coal processing chain remains active to support tar production.
I also expanded territory slightly to the west in preparation for additional ash processing infrastructure.
Unfortunately, due to the number of small tasks throughout the day, I did not have enough time to actually construct the new ash processing sector.
That will be the top priority for tomorrow.
On the research front, I completed additional chunk expansions along with Basic Crafting Speed 2 and Basic Mining Speed 2.
At this point, most of the core infrastructure and base upgrades are nearing completion.
I will reach out to fellow engineers through telecommunications to determine the best direction for future research and technological progression.
